picks.rationale: A major Japanese RPG publisher says on record that it is researching AI, but only where it improves game quality. This is a fresh studio-policy stance and the newest item in the pool.
picks.excerpt: 'The best way to would be in a way that actually improves the quality of the game'

picks.rationale: A concrete art-direction finding: DLSS 5 neural rendering usually hurts stylized looks but works in the Melee Unlocked PC port. Artists can act on this directly. It is a different story from the 09-25 OpenDLSS card.
picks.excerpt: Super Smash Bros. Melee native PC port Melee Unlocked adds NVIDIA DLSS 5 Neural Rendering in latest update

picks.rationale: RGG Studio recreated a real person's likeness through traditional research instead of generative AI. It is a timely craft case study on digital likeness, with EU deepfake rules in the background.
picks.excerpt: RGG Studio revealed it revived Tupac Shakur as a Stranger Than Heaven character using traditional research methods rather than generative AI.

picks.rationale: A pipeline-level roundup of Gamescom 2026 3D tech, including emerging AI-assisted asset workflows. It is the most directly actionable pick for 3D and game artists.
picks.excerpt: Gamescom 2026 highlighted advances in ray-traced rendering, dense geometry, scalable asset creation, proprietary engines, and emerging AI-assisted 3D workflows.

picks.rationale: The co-founder of Warhorse (Kingdom Come: Deliverance) gives his view on AI in game development. It adds a fresh AAA-studio voice from a fifth outlet.
